clips.text: Welcome aboard our Schweizer two thirty-three. I will fly while you enjoy the view. This is a simulated local discovery flight. Open Menu whenever you want to pause or finish.
clips.spoken_text: Welcome aboard our Schweizer two thirty-three. I will fly while you enjoy the view. This is a simulated local discovery flight. Open Menu whenever you want to pause or finish.

clips.text: Welcome aboard. This shorter tour starts already airborne. I have the controls. We will look for rising air, enjoy the Boulder panorama, and return for an unpowered landing.
clips.spoken_text: Welcome aboard. This shorter tour starts already airborne. I have the controls. We will look for rising air, enjoy the Boulder panorama, and return for an unpowered landing.

clips.text: The towplane is taking us up. Notice the rope ahead and the small control corrections. The sailplane has no engine; the tug supplies the energy for this climb.
clips.spoken_text: The towplane is taking us up. Notice the rope ahead and the small control corrections. The sailplane has no engine; the tug supplies the energy for this climb.

clips.text: We have reached our release area. Releasing now. Watch the towplane separate, and listen as its engine fades away.
clips.spoken_text: We have reached our release area. Releasing now. Watch the towplane separate, and listen as its engine fades away.

clips.text: We are looking for a column of rising air called a thermal. I will turn smoothly to stay with the lift. The sound and instruments will help us tell whether we are climbing.
clips.spoken_text: We are looking for a column of rising air called a thermal. I will turn smoothly to stay with the lift. The sound and instruments will help us tell whether we are climbing.

clips.text: Now we are gaining energy in the rising air. We can climb without an engine because the air is rising faster than the sailplane sinks through it.
clips.spoken_text: Now we are gaining energy in the rising air. We can climb without an engine because the air is rising faster than the sailplane sinks through it.

clips.text: We have gained some height. Let us use it for a look around Boulder. You can keep enjoying the view, or choose Take control from Menu during a stable glide.
clips.spoken_text: We have gained some height. Let us use it for a look around Boulder. You can keep enjoying the view, or choose Take control from Menu during a stable glide.

clips.text: We are returning to the airport with height in reserve. In a sailplane, we plan the landing before that margin gets small.
clips.spoken_text: We are returning to the airport with height in reserve. In a sailplane, we plan the landing before that margin gets small.

clips.text: The lift or our remaining height calls for an earlier return. We will shorten the sightseeing and keep a useful landing margin.
clips.spoken_text: The lift or our remaining height calls for an earlier return. We will shorten the sightseeing and keep a useful landing margin.

clips.text: The airport is ahead. I am arranging our unpowered landing circuit. Airbrakes will help control the descent while pitch controls our speed.
clips.spoken_text: The airport is ahead. I am arranging our unpowered landing circuit. Airbrakes will help control the descent while pitch controls our speed.

clips.text: We are lined up for landing. Notice the airbrake handle moving as I adjust the approach. I will round out close to the surface and brake after touchdown.
clips.spoken_text: We are lined up for landing. Notice the airbrake handle moving as I adjust the approach. I will round out close to the surface and brake after touchdown.

clips.text: We have landed and stopped. The sailplane cannot taxi under its own power. Open Menu to repeat the tour, choose a lesson, or finish the flight.
clips.spoken_text: We have landed and stopped. The sailplane cannot taxi under its own power. Open Menu to repeat the tour, choose a lesson, or finish the flight.

clips.text: You have the controls. Make small, coordinated movements and keep a safe airspeed. The pause menu lets you ask me to resume, or return to the airport.
clips.spoken_text: You have the controls. Make small, coordinated movements and keep a safe airspeed. The pause menu lets you ask me to resume, or return to the airport.

clips.text: I have the controls. I will continue from our current position, keeping the airport within reach.
clips.spoken_text: I have the controls. I will continue from our current position, keeping the airport within reach.

clips.text: Boulder Reservoir is the broad stretch of water to the north. It is a recreation area and a water-storage facility, and a useful landmark for finding the airport.
clips.spoken_text: Boulder Reservoir is the broad stretch of water to the north. It is a recreation area and a water-storage facility, and a useful landmark for finding the airport.

clips.text: Mount Sanitas marks part of the foothill edge west of Boulder. Notice how quickly the open plains rise into wooded slopes.
clips.spoken_text: Mount Sanitas marks part of the foothill edge west of Boulder. Notice how quickly the open plains rise into wooded slopes.

clips.text: Those tilted rock formations are the Flatirons, with Green Mountain behind them. We are enjoying the panorama from this side of the foothills.
clips.spoken_text: Those tilted rock formations are the Flatirons, with Green Mountain behind them. We are enjoying the panorama from this side of the foothills.

clips.text: Downtown Boulder lies below the foothills. From here, you can see the city spread eastward onto the plains.
clips.spoken_text: Downtown Boulder lies below the foothills. From here, you can see the city spread eastward onto the plains.

clips.text: That is the University of Colorado Boulder campus, south of downtown. The campus and the mountain backdrop are familiar landmarks on a local scenic flight.
clips.spoken_text: That is the University of Colorado Boulder campus, south of downtown. The campus and the mountain backdrop are familiar landmarks on a local scenic flight.

clips.text: There is Boulder Municipal Airport. Keep it in view as we prepare to return. We share the area with other aircraft and gliders.
clips.spoken_text: There is Boulder Municipal Airport. Keep it in view as we prepare to return. We share the area with other aircraft and gliders.

clips.text: Look ahead on the left. A golden eagle is circling in the rising air. We will give it room and enjoy the view.
clips.spoken_text: Look ahead on the left. A golden eagle is circling in the rising air. We will give it room and enjoy the view.

clips.text: Look ahead on the right. A golden eagle is circling in the rising air. We will give it room and enjoy the view.
clips.spoken_text: Look ahead on the right. A golden eagle is circling in the rising air. We will give it room and enjoy the view.

clips.text: Look ahead and slightly above us. A golden eagle is using the rising air too. We will give it room.
clips.spoken_text: Look ahead and slightly above us. A golden eagle is using the rising air too. We will give it room.
